_comment: Documentation word budgets, enforced by tests/docs/test_doc_budgets.py from the ci.yml docs job. Metric: one word per CJK character plus one word per maximal latin/digit run, counted after stripping fenced code blocks and HTML comments. Calibration: README.md and docs/future-roadmap.md are current size +20%, pages/*.md entries were recalibrated to post-expansion size +30% after the contract-body migration. Keys starting with '_' document the manifest and are not budgets.
_recalibration: pages/architecture.md 6300 -> 6800 (2026-09-20, merged batch): both work packages grew that page with contract bodies instead of the budget absorbing slack, so the two bumps compound rather than overlap. WP1 (IME-window collapse) added the soft-keyboard mark rules (only action keys stay candidates, no synthetic marks) and the `keyboard: open (N keys collapsed)` note line under #marks-first; WP3 (addressing + verdict persistence) added the describing-vs-visual addressing rule, the text-miss receipt hint and the persisted finish-verifier verdict — the text the P0 table's #marks-first / #tool-fail-closed / #finish-two-step anchors now carry. 6800 is the post-merge size (6761 words) rounded up to the nearest hundred, the same tight-budget convention as the earlier 6300 / 6500 / 6700 steps.
_agents_note: AGENTS.md migration is complete: the P0 contract bodies now live in pages/ behind stable anchors and this index is all that stays resident, so 2100 (its 1955 words + 10%, rounded to the nearest hundred) is the hard ceiling, no longer a placeholder for a larger target.
_recalibration_plugin_plane: plugin-plane v2 Round 1 (declaration plane): AGENTS.md 2100 -> 2200 and pages/plugins.md 2100 -> 2600 (2026-09-25). The P0 #18 row now carries the declaration-plane red line (declarations only classify/account, never allow, always fail-visible) because that is the wording a plugin author must be able to quote, and the Module Map gained v2/tool_risk.py (the built-in tool-risk declaration table). pages/plugins.md gained the declaration points themselves: register_tool(tool, risk=...), the fail-closed undeclared default, harness-owned service protection, register_pin_prefix, the --<name> plugin CLI commands, and the three legal CapabilitySpec.mode values. Both numbers are the post-edit size rounded up to the nearest hundred, the same convention as the pages/architecture.md step; pages/safety.md absorbed its contract change (declaration-driven classification, fail-closed undeclared default) inside its existing 1900.
_subtree_agents_note: 子目录 AGENTS.md，DSH 层级：pages/AGENTS.md、phone_agent/v2/AGENTS.md、phone_agent/web/AGENTS.md 与 tests/AGENTS.md 是就近约束，沿用 DeepSeek Harness packages/AGENTS.md 的口径，各按 750 词上限校验。
_recalibration_plugin_plane_round2: plugin-plane v2 Round 2 (declaration plane, second batch): pages/plugins.md 2600 -> 3100 (2026-09-25). The page gained the three new declaration points — declared configuration keys (ctx.register_setting, its precedence chain and the read-only V2Config.plugin_settings mirror), declared accounting roles (register_usage_role, token vs calls and the budget boundary) and declared redaction literals (register_redaction, min-length guard, shared ownership) — plus the manifest [plugin.config] pass-through and the observe event's screen_hash. 3100 is the post-edit size (3033 words) rounded up to the nearest hundred, the same convention as the Round 1 bump. AGENTS.md (2177), pages/configuration.md (7191) and phone_agent/v2/AGENTS.md (735) absorbed their contract text inside their existing budgets.
_recalibration_plugin_plane_round3: plugin-plane v2 Round 3 (run context and ordering): pages/plugins.md 3100 -> 3400 and pages/safety.md 1900 -> 2000 (2026-09-25). pages/plugins.md gained the two Runtime facts a plugin author now needs — the harness-owned read-only run_context service (run_id / actor_model fixed at assembly, goal only once a run starts, absent on the CLI maintenance path) and the before/after ordering hints (topological resolution, cycle and unknown-name failure, vacuous at a disabled target, coexistence with prepend=True) — plus the two field names in the CapabilitySpec list; pages/safety.md's classification paragraph now states that the hard-mode interrupt table covers every registered tool except the declared-readonly ones, resolved live. Both numbers are the post-edit size (3295 / 1961 words) rounded up to the nearest hundred, the same convention as the Round 1/2 bumps. AGENTS.md (2190) and phone_agent/v2/AGENTS.md (745) absorbed the declaration-list wording inside their existing budgets.
_recalibration_plugin_plane_round4: plugin-plane v2 Round 4 (first-party systemone plugin): pages/plugins.md 3400 -> 3600 (2026-09-25). The page gained the first-party plugin entry — its four seams (provider family, shadow safety review with the additive-veto condition, the readonly wait_for_stable tool, the advisory governor), the disabled-by-default manifest entry and where its keys/limitations live — plus the corrected index.json line (it now registers the in-repo plugin instead of claiming an empty community index). 3600 is the post-edit size (3511 words) rounded up to the nearest hundred, the same convention as the Round 1/2/3 bumps. tests/AGENTS.md absorbed the new tests/plugins/ domain line by tightening its own wording (745 words, inside the unchanged 750 subtree cap).
